basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a long-time Redditor based in Texas. I have a background in agricultural studies and grew up on a cattle ranch, which heavily influences my interest in diet and nutrition. I'm passionate about exploring various dietary lifestyles, especially the carnivore diet, despite my current challenges with red meat allergies. I work as a freelance writer, which allows me to balance my time between research and contributing to online discussions. I'm married, and my husband and I are always experimenting with new recipes and ways to optimize our health. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive knowledge of animal husbandry and nutritional science, primarily through my upbringing on a cattle ranch and self-directed research. I frequently update my understanding of dietary trends and health science by following academic journals and participating in relevant online communities.
